item.title: A message from Guidance:
item.description: Last call for any grade 12 students interested in attending Trent University's presentation tomorrow during period 4. Sign up in the Guidance office if you're interested in attending.

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Need a place to casually interact with ideas and share your thoughts? The philosphy and debate club will get together every Tuesday at 10:50am in the chapel for high school students to engage in critical thinking and to socialize.

item.title: A message from Mr. D'Alessio:
item.description: There is a Drama Club meeting Wednesday at 10:40AM in Rm.209. New members gr.9-12 are welcome.

item.title: A message from the Main Office:
item.description: This is a message for all bike riders - reminding all students to please lock up your bikes on the bike racks in the back of the school. Students should not be taking bikes that do not belong to them at any time.

item.title: A message from Mr. Cornellier:
item.description: Any girls in grades 9 and 10 who are interested in weekly volleyball sessions are asked to come out on Wednesdays after school, from 2:20-3:45. This is an excellent opportunity to get ready for tryouts. Please see Mr. Cornellier if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Ms. Clune:
item.description: Looking forward to seeing you at our 7/8 Cross Country practice today. Please meet in Room 144 at 2:15.
